description: Marks a step's checkpoint image as accepted or rejected, per `action` — see its own description for what each one does to the baseline. Only call this once the step's differences have actually been investigated and judged (see the eyes_inspect_* tools). By default also accepts (or rejects) every other still-unresolved step that genuinely shares this step's diff, across this session and same-scenario siblings — see propagate; a candidate that already has its own accept/reject decision is left alone. A low-level primitive: for a driven review that also resolves what it finds, use eyes_review_progress with mode: "resolve" instead — it calls this deterministically from its own findings. Call this directly only for a one-off manual decision outside that review.

action.description: Which decision to mark. "accept": its baseline image will be replaced by the checkpoint the next time eyes_resolve_save runs. "reject": its baseline image is retained.

propagate.description: Which other steps also get this exact change, applied together in the same tool call. Omitted (default): every other step of this session, plus every step of every other session sharing this session's exact scenario name (its other browsers/OS/viewports) — narrowed to the steps that actually apply before anything is sent. "none": only this step — opt out of the default. Any other string: an additional regex tested against every session's scenario name, e.g. "Login|Checkout" — sessions matching are included in the candidate pool on top of the same-scenario default.

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_resolve_checkpoint
